Method of Attack: Setting the Content-Type of the attacker's HTML/JS page or hidden service in the Tor network to "text/html/json" to suppress NoScript's reaction and permit all JavaScript code through, bypassing the 'Safest' security level that blocks all JavaScript.
Attack Vector: Malicious HTML/JS page or hidden service in the Tor network with manipulated Content-Type header
Indicators of Compromise: Content-Type header set to "text/html/json" in attacker's HTML/JS page or hidden service
